text-align: left;

b.span: Single VM · Compose projects `umtas-prod` + `umtas-proxy` · Public host capstone-vigil.dns.net.za

span.style: font-size: 24px; text-align: left;

a.xlink:href:
Here is the updated table reflecting the production environment network. I also fixed the small typo on "RAM scratch" for you.

Note: For all lines, the arrow direction indicates the flow from initiator to responder.

CategoryVisual ElementMeaning
LineSolidPublic HTTPS/HTTP (internet boundary)
LineSolidInternal HTTP between services
LineSolidDatastore protocol (PG wire, RESP, S3)
LineSolidPersistent volume mount
LineDashedMessage queue (BullMQ over Redis)
LineDashedControl plane (SSH, docker.sock, ACME, secrets)
ShapeGroup with Server Icon («device»)VM / Machine
ShapeGroup / Box («executionEnvironment»)Engine, project, container
ShapeBlue Box («network»)Gateway (B3)
ShapeOrange Box («network»)umtas-prod-internal (B4)
ShapePurple Cylinder («external»)Third-party service
ShapeGrey Cylinder («volume»)Docker named volume
ShapeDashed Cylinder («tmpfs»)RAM scratch
ShapeDocument («artifact» / «deploymentSpec»)Artifact / Deployment Spec
